name: POTABA
question: Does oral potassium paraaminobenzoate improve plaque or curvature outcomes compared with placebo in early Peyronie's disease?

design.population: Previously untreated men with Peyronie's disease for no more than 12 months and noncalcified plaques; diabetes, compensated nephropathy, chronic gastric or bowel disease, and absent response to intracavernosal injection were excluded.
design.locator: Full text, Patients and methods, p 531; Table 1

verdictNote: Composite response met the prespecified 0.05 threshold among 75 completers; 28 randomized men were excluded.
takeaway: In 75 completers, oral potassium paraaminobenzoate improved composite plaque or curvature response versus placebo (26/35 [74.3%] versus 20/40 [50.0%]; P = 0.016); pre-existing curvature improvement did not differ significantly.

reports.label: Primary report
reports.citation: Weidner W, Hauck EW, Schnitker J, et al. "Potassium paraaminobenzoate (POTABA) in the treatment of Peyronie's disease: a prospective, placebo-controlled, randomized study." *Eur Urol.* 2005;47(4):530-536. doi:10.1016/j.eururo.2004.12.022
reports.followUpLocator: Full text, Patients and methods, p 531

results.measure: Complete resolution or plaque-size reduction and/or at least 30% curvature reduction at 12 months among 75 valid cases
results.note: The protocol specified alpha = 0.05 for response-rate superiority and planned at least 46 completers per group; no effect confidence interval was reported.
results.locator: Full text, Patients and methods, p 531; Results 3.2, p 532

results.measure: Baseline-adjusted mean plaque area, baseline to 12 months
results.note: Figure 1 reports baseline-adjusted means; placebo mean increased to 303 mm² at 6 months. P = 0.042 is the reported two-sided treatment effect in the ANCOVA.
results.locator: Full text, Abstract, Results; Results 3.2 and Fig. 1, p 532

results.note: No between-group difference in improvement was reported; curvature angles were not reported.

results.measure: New or worsened curvature during treatment
results.note: P = 0.001 is the reported between-group comparison of new or worsened curvature; no effect confidence interval was reported.

results.endpoint: New curvature in initially straight men
results.measure: New penile curvature during 12 months among valid cases without baseline deviation
results.note: The small initially straight subgroup is included in the overall curvature-deterioration result.
No significant between-group difference was reported; event numerators and pain-subgroup denominators were not given.

harms.label: Severe adverse events
harms.locator: Full text, Abstract, Results; Results 3.1, p 532
harms.note: No clinically significant pathological laboratory values were observed.

harms.label: Withdrawal due to side effects
harms.note: In the active group, one withdrawal each was attributed to pruritus, fever, and chills.

harms.label: Withdrawal due to gastrointestinal disorders
harms.note: These eight withdrawals are included in the side-effect withdrawal counts.

delivery.label: Oral treatment schedule
delivery.value: Potassium paraaminobenzoate powder 3 g four times daily (12 g/day) or placebo powder for 12 months.
delivery.locator: Full text, Patients and methods, p 531

delivery.label: Study completion
delivery.value: 35/51 potassium paraaminobenzoate recipients and 40/52 placebo recipients completed treatment (75/103 total) and formed the valid-case analysis.

delivery.label: Nonadherence exclusions
delivery.note: Participants reported not taking the powder regularly; these 17 men were excluded from the valid-case analysis.

delivery.label: Plaque and curvature assessment
delivery.value: Plaque length and width were measured by caliper on the stretched flaccid penis; curvature was assessed from standardized erection photographs after intracavernosal prostaglandin E1 and manual stimulation.
delivery.locator: Full text, Patients and methods, p 531
